pairs.evidence: examples/hirelane/lib/scoring.ts:2 Hirelane's 'candidates' are job applicants, scored by a transparent keyword rubric over CV sentences, not trained models. Nothing measures a dataset, fills a template, trains or ensembles anything, so the measure-generate-train-select arc never applies. A search of examples/hirelane (node_modules excluded) for hyperparameter, ensemble, epoch, learning_rate and datastats found no hits.
